title: Copy the raw URL of a GitHub file
question: How do I get the raw link to a file on GitHub quickly?
answer: On a GitHub file page, right-click the Raw button and copy the link; it goes through a redirect to raw.githubusercontent.com. GitHub's own copy button next to Raw copies the file's contents, not its address. The usermods script on this page adds a Copy URL button to that group that copies the direct raw.githubusercontent.com address of the file in one click. Without an extension, the right-click on Raw or editing the URL by hand are the ways.
prompt: Add a button next to Raw on GitHub file pages that copies the file's raw URL.
details:
The address is built from the Raw button's own link: `github.com/<owner>/<repo>/raw/<ref>/<path>` becomes `raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<ref>/<path>`, the address GitHub redirects to. The button reads the link when you click, so it stays right after you move to another file without a page load.

For private repositories the copied address needs a token to open, as GitHub's own raw links do.

alternatives.title: Right-click Raw
alternatives.body: Right-click **Raw** on the file page and choose **Copy Link Address**. The link is a `github.com/.../raw/...` address that redirects to raw.githubusercontent.com.

alternatives.title: Edit the URL
alternatives.body: Change `github.com` to `raw.githubusercontent.com` and remove `/blob` from a file's address: `github.com/react/react/blob/main/README.md` becomes `raw.githubusercontent.com/react/react/main/README.md`.

check.actions: window.__copied = null; navigator.clipboard.writeText = (text) => { window.__copied = text; return Promise.resolve(); }; const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((e) => /Copy URL/.test(e.textContent)); if (b) { b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); }
check.baseline: (() => { const raw = document.querySelector('a[data-testid="raw-button"]'); const group = raw && raw.closest('[data-component="ButtonGroup"]'); return !!raw && raw.checkVisibility() && /\/raw\//.test(raw.href) && !!group && ![...group.querySelectorAll('button, a')].some((e) => /Copy URL/.test(e.textContent)) && window.__copied === null; })()
check.intact: (() => { const raw = document.querySelector('a[data-testid="raw-button"]'); const copy = document.querySelector('[data-testid="copy-raw-button"]'); return !!raw && raw.checkVisibility() && !!copy && copy.checkVisibility() && /resolveDispatcher/.test(document.body.innerText); })()
